title: RGB Chat
description: RGB colored chat and text: #RRGGBB tags and #RRGGBB-RRGGBB gradients, drawn client-side. No server mod needed.

versions.changelog:
Modern UI compatibility overhaul: full per-character RGB rendering under Modern UI's text engine, with color tags hidden live in every input box.

### Added
- Modern UI compatibility for chat, signs, anvils and item names — true per-character RGB rendering through Modern UI's text engine
- Live tag hiding in the chat and anvil rename input boxes with exact cursor, selection and scrolling behavior
- Sign edit screen: color tags are hidden while typing and no longer count toward the per-line width limit
- Modern UI tooltips: gradient-colored item names drive the tooltip border with their own stop colors instead of the rainbow spectrum

### Fixed
- Game crash when opening the anvil screen with Modern UI loaded
- Input-box crash when typing a complete color tag under Modern UI (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in Modern UI's EditBox handler)
- Scrolling long inputs no longer leaves stray uppercase hex fragments at the cursor
- Colored anvil renames no longer bump the item rarity (epic-purple tooltip border removed)
- Multi-stop gradient tags are now hidden correctly while typing in every input box
- Signs: color tags no longer eat the line's width budget

26.x platforms (26.1.2 / 26.2) are unchanged from v1.0.1.
